verdict.rationale: The skill uses the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md) and claims it works in any agent that supports skills. Install steps are documented for Claude Code (plugin marketplace), for a generic skills-directory copy, and for uploading via Settings. Missing for 10: per-harness install instructions for Codex, Cursor and other named agents, and hands-on confirmation that it runs across multiple harnesses.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the same collection into multiple different coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others — with per-harness instructions

citations.quote: The skill uses the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md), so it works in any agent that supports skills
Copy the skill folder into your personal (all projects) or project skills directory
upload it under Settings → Capabilities → Skills
